data.creator_notes:
Teaching Feeling might be… weird. But it is one of the best romance VNs ever, and Sylvie deserves a worthy bot.

After using the Sylvie bot made by @Arthur.xds for quite a while and eventually getting frustrated because how poorly made it is (Probably machine translated from another language, most likely Spanish) and seeing that there are few other Sylvie bots in chub and all of the same quality, I decided to make a Sylvie bot myself.

I wouldn’t say this is “The perfect Sylvie bot” and I’m sure I can do a lot better, but I’m satisfied with how it is now. Feel free to modify this bot to your heart’s content and if you have any suggestion, complainant, correction, or want to insult me, feel free to leave it in the discussion.

English is not my native language so there might be some errors, but I’m pretty confident on my English. If I do make any spelling mistake or something, please correct me.

Do not expect me to make any new bots that don’t relate to this one, but if you want me to make an alternate vercion of this bot let me know (Specially If you want it in Spanish, that it’s where the community is the strongest).

Alternate avatars in gallery. You might like one of them more than the one I put as default.

Art and teaching feeling by Ray-Kybs (He doesn’t like it when his art is used by anyone for anything, oh no)

Lastly, really, please give me any advice you might have to improve this bot.

Enjoy!
